referenceKind: Measured live no-code page plus owner annotated before/after examples; attachment pixels are not CSS measurements

required.fullMerchantIdentity: offer-detail main coupon and store identity; ordinary summaries retain source and accessible full identity
required.merchantCountRoleCoverage: Real existing coupon counts and update hooks; explicit per-site selector coverage

boundary: Targets are starting budgets. Ordinary coupon titles and merchant names use one-line ellipsis in fixed family/viewport capacity. Only offer-detail main coupon and store identity use full-content rules. Never clip actions, state or code.
compactPreview: Ordinary coupon titles and merchant names use one-line ellipsis on PC and phone, retaining full source and correct detail access. Store first item is an ordinary card. Offer-detail main coupon and store identity remain fully visible.
discovery: Preserve required primary recommendations and existing desktop sidebar scope; prioritize complementary merchants and remove phone cross-region duplicates already fully represented in primary recommendations. Measure both column endings and resolve large accidental whitespace without padding filler.
stateCoverage: Real unavailable/withdrawn detail samples use the full viewport and breakpoint matrix, including extracted ZIP PC and phone. Only absent claim roles are exempt. No real sample is N/A; an unvisited cell is not-run.

layout.cardComposition: free within purpose and mandatory rules

recommendedCoupons.moduleArrangement: Choose per site, module and breakpoint: one card per row or a capacity-appropriate multi-column layout; no universal orientation or column count
recommendedCoupons.cardComposition: Choose logo, text, metadata and action grouping independently of the module column count; horizontal and vertical cards are both valid
recommendedCoupons.reviewBasis: Actual hierarchy, density, cumulative spacing, readable capacity and action alignment; neither resemblance to reference orientation nor layout difference alone establishes a pass
recommendedCoupons.preserve: Module order, real quantities and destinations, offer-detail main coupon full text; merchant-page first item uses ordinary summary capacity, declared fixed summary capacity, logo and touch-area minimums

sidebarMerchants.quantityCoverage: Enumerate original merchant nodes, native count classes and update hooks separately for each page family; a zero match on added markers is not evidence of no visible quantity

layout.topicNavigation: Semantic icon left of or above a left-aligned name, compact grouping; preserve site-specific reading paths and actual host-width capacity.

ownerConfirmed20261022.main: information and claim within one unified visual region
ownerConfirmed20261022.headerSearch: visible vertical inset with actual accessible targets
ownerConfirmed20261022.mobile: single existing outer gutter; no nested horizontal gutters

moduleStyleFreedom: Main claim frame may differ from recommended coupon frame; maintain brand and business hierarchy

quietVisualHierarchy.defaultFrame: thin pale neutral outline or restrained shadow; include SVG paths and pseudo-elements
quietVisualHierarchy.brandBorder: interaction state, restore pale frame on pointer exit without geometry shift
quietVisualHierarchy.colorFocus: primary action and a few meaningful accents; dark offer title, muted readable metadata
quietVisualHierarchy.density: Group actual fields and remove omitted-field tracks before assigning summary capacity; no oversized empty summary slots
quietVisualHierarchy.compositionFreedom: Preserve per-site and per-module grouping, outlines and phone composition; compactness is not a universal row template
quietVisualHierarchy.review: Observe default and interactive states for every project on PC, phone and 320px; first coupon full text remains an exception

recommendationFieldBoundaries.logo: Measure link, every inner wrapper and actual image separately; no padding/border/transform overflow
recommendationFieldBoundaries.decoration: SVG/pseudo background rails and splits follow actual field boundaries, never a stale hardcoded width
recommendationFieldBoundaries.text: Measure visible glyphs inside allocated slots and exclude Logo/rail/action collisions, including dates and post-redraw nodes
recommendationFieldBoundaries.density: Choose purposeful columns and field groups per site/device; neither a universally stretched horizontal row nor forced portrait tiles
recommendationFieldBoundaries.counterexample: RallyPerks/Castlery fixed 95px SVG rail beyond the actual title start, owner rejected on 2026-10-21

categoryMeasurement.requiredWhen: Category navigation is within the authorized change or affected regression scope
categoryMeasurement.countAndIdentitySource: Frozen catalogue and explicit editorial selection, never inferred from the tested DOM
categoryMeasurement.otherIconImplementations: Require equivalent browser evidence; do not report unsupported inspection as passed
categoryMeasurement.scope: Coverage, final glyph size, colored SVG paint, own text slots, field collisions, declared alignment, markers, target size and actual host width; full natural-wrapping topic labels; vertical icon/text center alignment and horizontal left-aligned text through the shared topic inspector
categoryMeasurement.limits: Does not establish semantic icon meaning, visual quality, cross-site distinction, real navigation or complete release acceptance; referenced SVG paint is explicitly not-run, not a colorless-icon failure; slot and actual text alignment are distinct; icon family names or geometry fingerprints alone cannot prove semantic correctness or cross-site visual distinction
categoryMeasurement.legacyTextMode: Only for previously frozen packages; current categories require icons and global topic checks.
